summary: Full backend + frontend testing of DocGalaxy E-Stamping app. All 14 backend pytest cases pass (auth, OTP, access control, orders CRUD, submit-locks-draft, admin orders & payment, reviews moderation). Frontend end-to-end flow verified: Home page renders estamping H1 + services + FAQ, customer OTP login (mobile+name+123456) lands on dashboard, E-Stamping form keeps focus while typing, searchable Document combobox lists 59 Gujarat articles and selection updates trigger, auto-save shows 'Draft saved', Submit confirm dialog locks form read-only (readonly-badge visible, inputs disabled). Dashboard lists submitted orders. Review submission works. Admin login works, orders table renders 7 rows, payment-toggle flips to Paid (toast visible), View & Bookmarklet dialog shows order details with draggable SHCIL Autofill bookmarklet and Copy Code, Reviews tab shows approve/reject buttons and approval works.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is accepted by Starlette but is not recommended for production - set explicit origins when deploying.
No pagination on GET /api/orders (limit 1000) or /api/admin/orders (2000) - fine for MVP but will need pagination at scale.
OTP is intentionally mocked - fine per spec, but there is no rate limiting on request-otp (DoS surface) - acceptable for demo.
server.py is 378 lines - still manageable but splitting routes into modules (auth/orders/admin/reviews) will help as it grows.
